templates.name: Decision Matrix
templates.whenToUse: Use for choosing between options with shared evaluation dimensions, tradeoffs, risks, or recommendations.
rendererNotes: Use aligned option cards with matching internal rows.
Use a compact legend when tones distinguish recommendation, tradeoff, and risk.

templates.name: KPI Dashboard
templates.whenToUse: Use for operational snapshots, metrics, status cards, active alerts, and recommended next actions.
rendererNotes: Prioritize scan order over dense routing.
Use larger metric text and short labels.

templates.name: Organization Hierarchy
templates.whenToUse: Use for org charts, ownership trees, taxonomies, responsibility maps, or nested parent-child structures.
rendererNotes: Use a clear root node and aligned child rows.
Use dashed edges for escalation or optional ownership paths.

templates.name: Cause Effect Map
templates.whenToUse: Use for causal chains, contributing factors, feedback causes, symptoms, outcomes, and mitigation paths.
rendererNotes: Keep causes on one side and effects on the other when possible.
Use label backgrounds for causal connector labels.

templates.name: Swimlane Workflow
templates.whenToUse: Use when a process spans multiple actors, systems, departments, or responsibility lanes.
rendererNotes: Use one group per lane.
Keep cross-lane connectors orthogonal.

templates.name: Roadmap Timeline
templates.whenToUse: Use for milestones, roadmap phases, release plans, maturity stages, and time-based transitions.
rendererNotes: Use stable intervals and phase groups.
Keep dates or phase labels short.

templates.name: Architecture Stack
templates.whenToUse: Use for platform layers, data stacks, service tiers, capability layers, and zone-based architecture.
rendererNotes: Use full-width layer groups.
Use chips or small cards for peer components inside layers.

templates.name: Dark Layered Architecture
templates.whenToUse: Use for AI-era systems, AIoT, IoT, edge-cloud architectures, and product-grade architecture diagrams that need visible layers, component chips, and bidirectional data/control flows.
rendererNotes: Use the source response's semantic layers and flows first; the template is a visual carrier, not the source of truth.
Use a dark canvas with four or more full-width rounded layer bands.
Put compact component chips inside each layer rather than prose cards.
Add side rails for upstream data flow and downstream AI/control flow when both are present.
Use bottom legend swatches for layer semantics and keep all labels short.

templates.name: Feedback Loop
templates.whenToUse: Use for observe-act-learn systems, control loops, RL loops, calibration, deployment feedback, and monitoring loops.
rendererNotes: Use opposing arrows for action and feedback.
Use dashed secondary paths for optional calibration or deployment.

templates.name: Concept Map
templates.whenToUse: Use for topic maps, knowledge systems, chapter maps, principle clusters, or a central idea with related concepts.
rendererNotes: Place the central concept near the center or top center.
Use groups for related clusters.

templates.name: Freeform Insight Map
templates.whenToUse: Use for assistant responses that contain mixed signals, recommendations, risks, and evidence that do not fit a strict sequence, hierarchy, or matrix.
rendererNotes: Cluster related signals without forcing a symmetric layout.
Keep connector labels short and use label backgrounds or masks.
